versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Snapchat Filter Art Generator.
- Generate nostalgic selfies with classic Snapchat-style filters like puppy ears, flower crowns, dog tongues, sparkles, and bunny noses.
- Designed for creating 2010s/early-iPhone aesthetic, Y2K/Instagram throwbacks, and viral "2026 is the new 2016" content.
- Uses the Neta AI image generation API (requires free trial token from neta.art).
- Includes options for image size and style reference.
